conclusions: XNAS.ITCH, EQUS.MINI, and Schwab bars must not be timestamp-merged as if they were one homogeneous feed.
Databento native and normalized files are distinct provider evidence encodings; OPRA date partitions are the atomic verification boundary.
Migration rollback copies and abandoned unverified staging attempts are the safe reclaimable classes.
